TOOLING BURST BL-2v — Blackwater arm B: the VIDEO SPINE bound as the field body (Run C-7, P1; Matt R-C7-0 / R-C7-0b / R-C7-0d / R-C7-0e; charter v1.0 § 3). task_id "BL-2v".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4s (all clauses), T4s-r2 (GroundEffects layer), T4s-r3 (painted pool binding), BL-1a (walkable landing, tick body_index), FL-2 (eased floor light), FL-5 (Part C: core_residue + smoke sheet), and the new row "BL-2v — Blackwater arm B: the video spine as the field body" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-7/artifacts/BW-video-r1/frames.json (the cut manifest: 145 frames, 24 fps, cell 485x581, pool_centre_px, timeline_s, per-frame sha) and runs/C-7/artifacts/BW-video-r1/frames/bw_000.png … bw_144.png (four-plane GREYSCALE value frames + hard alpha at scene scale; colour comes from the kit palette at runtime), runs/C-5/specs/blackwater_cocktail.json (LAW for numbers: rank 1, 181 px pool, ticks, scorch 12 s, range 520), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json (arm A — the runtime kit, unchanged), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, export/godot_import.py (G2 component: g2_thrown_field, landing resolution, ticks/victim_tint/contact_label, painted pool binding, scorch decal, GroundEffects z, SpriteFrames writer, floor light, the FL-5 smoke sheet), export/effect_kit.py (G2 validation), runs/C-5/cliffside_v44/ (staged, READ ONLY), runs/C-7/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = the conductor's).

WHAT THIS IS. Matt ruled (R-C7-0) that ONE video clip from CONTACT is the spine of the Blackwater effect: shatter → flash + ground ring → pool spreads → boils → dies → scorch, all in the 145 frames. The runtime glues the rest around it. Arm A (the runtime kit `blackwater_cocktail_e3`) stays byte-identical; you build arm B as a SECOND kit `blackwater_cocktail_e3_V` so both can be cast at the same spot for Matt's A/B.

PART A — THE SPINE AS THE FIELD BODY. New G2 field body mode `field.body_mode: "flipbook"` (the existing mode stays the default): the field body is an AnimatedSprite2D on the GroundEffects layer (same z as the painted pool) with a SpriteFrames animation of the 145 frames at 24 fps, 1x, NON-looping (R-C7-0d: 1x), drawn through the kit's value-index palette material (MIX, the same four-band ramp as arm A; band 0 = contour, band 3 = white core) — the frames are greyscale value planes, the palette colours them. Anchor: frames.json `pool_centre_px` [248,344] sits at the G2 landing point on the ground; no per-frame scale (the frames are already at scene scale — 362-px pool, aspect 0.58); no upscaling ever. Hand-off: the flask flight is UNCHANGED (walkable-landing clamp, 520 px touch range, 0.40 s); on landing, frame 0 plays at the landing point; the kit's own shatter/splash burst and its painted pool/licks are OFF for this kit (the clip carries contact and the pool). The frames are copied into the kit as `primitives/spine/bw_000..144.png` (byte-identical; assert the sha12 list against frames.json).
PART B — THE SCORCH IS THE HELD LAST FRAME. At frame 144 the animation stops and the node PERSISTS as the scorch decal for the spec's 12.0 s (fade over the last 1.0 s), then frees. One node per cast; casts ACCUMULATE (a second cast never removes or replaces the first cast's scorch) — R-C7-0e (2).
PART C — TICKS ON THE CLIP'S CLOCK. The spec's rank-1 tick schedule (pool life 0 / 1.0 / 2.0 s) maps onto the clip's steady window: clip time = timeline_s.pool_stable (0.75) + 0 / 1.0 / 2.0 → ticks at 0.75 / 1.75 / 2.75 s after landing; bodies whose feet are inside the pool ellipse (362 x 210 px at the landing point) at those times get the existing victim_tint / hit_stop / contact_label response with body_index; no ticks after timeline_s.steady_end (4.0 s).
PART D — RUNTIME LAYERS. (D1) eased floor light (the FL-2 recipe) born at contact under the pool, intensity following the flash (peak at 0.17 s) then the steady burn, fading out with the die-down by 5.0 s — this REPLACES the halo the model painted (keyed out at the cut). (D2) SMOKE (R-C7-0e (3)): the FL-5 smoke sheet (MIX, grey-warm noise, alpha .22, rise 22 px/s) centred on the pool, born at pool_stable (0.75 s), drawn ABOVE the flipbook so it mixes through the flames, thinning from dies_out (4.6 s) and gone by 6.0 s. (D3) dark duplicate OFF (the frames carry their own contour). (D4) no additive core, no licks, no erosion on this kit.
PART E — THE A/B PROBE (acceptance instrument). A headless probe (from probe_events.gd) that casts arm A then arm B east from (3760,640) at the same landing point, then casts B twice more, and writes runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v/ab_trace.json proving: B's frame 0 is at the landing point within 4 px; the animation frame index advances 24/s (frame 72 at 3.0 s ± 1 frame) and stops at 144; ticks fire at 0.75 / 1.75 / 2.75 s with body_index for a body inside the pool (place the hound as BL-1a did); the scorch node is alive at 6.0 + 11.0 s and freed by 6.0 + 12.1 s; after the two extra B casts three scorch nodes coexist; arm A's trace is byte-identical to its BL-1a-r1 trace.
PART F — CATALOGUE + TESTS. Register `blackwater_cocktail_e3_V` in runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json (path under runs/C-7/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3_V/); 19-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 on gl_compatibility; ALL 18 other kits byte-identical; tests (unittest, stdlib): flipbook body mode emission, held-last-frame decal lifetime + accumulation, tick mapping, smoke/floor-light presence, sha12 assertion of the copied frames; extend only. Inherited REDs (five standing oracle reds + the E3-r1 catalogue lock + the twelve FL-5/FL-6 stale-value tests + three Blackwater staged-copy tests, R-C5-139) stay red and are NAMED — do not weaken any of them; if one of them is a real regression of yours, fix it and say so.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v/acceptance.json): Part A sha12 assertion + scene emission; Part B lifetime + accumulation; Part C tick times; Part D node presence + z order (smoke above flipbook, floor light below); Part E ab_trace.json clauses; Part F export/import exits, byte identity table, in-sandbox suite with the named tests green and remaining reds NAMED.
DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any existing kit's files (registration line in kits_v9.json only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v/ and runs/C-7/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3_V/; fixtures/ only for a new fixture of your own. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-7/t3/BL-2v/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "BL-2v"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
